title.narrative: Reintegration Project for Children Formerly Associated with Armed Conflict - KAFAK

description.narrative: Direct beneficiaries: (460 beneficiaries) and the division is as follows: 200 children 200 guardians 60 community committee members Indirect beneficiaries: 20,000 beneficiaries

Reintegrating targeted children with their normal peers in society by providing safe shelter, psychological, social, health and educational support, returning them to school and following up with them, developing their abilities, talents and social participation. - Life skills training (for every child over 15 years old) such as computers. Parents of children: - Economically empowering parents of targeted children and providing them with professional tools. - Providing awareness and cultural courses for parents of targeted children to introduce children's rights and laws that criminalize child recruitment and involvement in armed conflict and the consequences on the child. Raising awareness in the community: - Establishing community committees concerned with monitoring and reporting on child protection, training and qualifying their members to spread culture in the community about children’s rights and working to protect them, and raising awareness of the crime of recruiting children and engaging in armed conflict.
Reintegration of children affected and formerly associated with armed conflict into society in Ma'rib Governorate and Seiyun City, Republic of Yemen
